transport.localCache: none: fresh curl process per resource request
transport.batchMode: all resources requested concurrently; deployment order alternated each round
transport.timingScope: DNS, TCP, TLS, server wait, and body transfer as reported by curl
transport.encodedBytes: curl size_download with --raw and Accept-Encoding br, gzip; response body bytes on the wire
transport.identityBytes: one additional identity-encoding GET per resource, used only for payload-size baseline
